messages:
Zara: Starting VelvetSilicon EAP thread. Partner wants a compact bench window, strict telemetry limits, and a co-listing if numbers look good. Who takes NDA edits?

Owen: I can do the NDA. Partner insists no raw prompt retention; hashed IDs allowed. They also asked for a 45-day retention window. I'll draft with KMS requirement.

Pri: Lab window tentative 8/8-8/11 UTC. Partner will provide 3x VLT-64 boards. Plan: micro-latency suite, mem-heavy pass, and a 12h soak. Need exact run commands to include in runbook.

Maeve: For bench flags suggest: `--model=redwood-3b --seq=1024 --batch=1 --warmup=40 --samples=300`. Capture cold (`--cache=off`) and steady (`--cache=on`). Log `p50,p95,p99,gpu_mem_mb,kv_hit_rate`.

Zara: Telemetry: partner only allows aggregated metrics + salted hashes of request ids. No prompt/response text. We must list hash algorithm in NDA.

LegalBot: Noted. Standard clause to add: "Exchange limited to aggregated performance metrics and cryptographic hashes (SHA-256) of request identifiers; no plaintext prompts or responses shall be retained or exchanged." Also include retention = 45 days and KMS encryption for artifacts.

Owen: Will add that wording and circulate. ETA 3 hours.

Pri: Runbook note: include `env` vars for partner image and a reproducible Docker command. Example: `docker run --rm -e PARTNER_KEY=$KEY velvet/bench:latest ./bench --model=redwood-3b --seq=1024 --batch=1 --samples=300 --cache=on` Save artifacts as `velvet_<date>_<phase>.json`.

Maeve: Partner telemetry endpoint request: `/metrics/velvet-eap` with counters: tokens_total, tokens_per_sec, p95_ms, gpu_util, kv_hit_rate. Also want `req_hash_count` for hashed IDs. Confirming not to include any prompt fragments.

Zara: Confirmed. We will expose aggregated counters only. PlatformBot, add checklist link.

PlatformBot: Checklist uploaded: `drive.redwood.com/velvet/eap-playbook-v1.md`. Contains telemetry schema, bench matrix, and minimal repro steps.

Owen: Quick Q: partner asked whether we can run a small opt-in profiling probe that captures CPU/GPU flamegraphs (no text). Is that allowed?

LegalBot: Allowed if results are aggregated and do not include memory dumps with plaintext. Add explicit line: "Profiling artifacts may be exchanged if scrubbed of any plaintext content and retained per retention policy."

Pri: We'll plan a short profiling capture (5-min sample) on one node only. Mark as opt-in in the checklist.

Maeve: Example sanitized pre-run: `{"model":"redwood-3b","phase":"cold","p50_ms":21.4,"p95_ms":88.7,"gpu_util":72.1}`. Use these sanitization rules in runbook.

Zara: Marketplace ops: we'll need a 60-80 word blurb, SVG+PNG logos, and a partner-approved quote if we're doing a co-list. Who owns blurb?

Pri: I can draft the blurb. Zara, can you ask partner for logos and a 1-2 sentence quote by 8/15?

Zara: On it. Also scheduling a short webinar week after soft co-list. Partner to confirm speaker.

Owen: Timeline recap: NDA -> Owen by EOD; bench dry-run -> Pri/Maeve by 8/9; full runs -> 8/11; artifacts uploaded -> 8/12; blurb + logos -> 8/15; soft co-list target -> 8/20.

Maeve: I'll include `kv_hit_rate` and `cache_mode` fields in artifacts and a short reproduce section.

Pri: I'll attach run scripts to the drive link and tag here when live. :rocket:

Zara: Action items summary in-thread: Owen -> NDA draft; Pri/Maeve -> bench runs and artifacts; Zara -> partner logo/quote/webinar; PlatformBot -> maintain playbook. Meeting Fri 10am UTC to review artifacts.

Owen: Drafted NDA uploaded to drive, pinging legal for quick review.

Pri: Uploaded preliminary runbook and a dry-run artifact link: `drive.redwood.com/velvet/dryrun-08-06.json`. Will run full suite on 8/9.

Zara: Thanks team ":thumbsup:" keeping this thread as single source for VelvetSilicon EAP ops.
